svg.aria-label: Constructed 4 ns and 2 ns photon-count experiments. A retains counts and fits after 1.2 ns; B subtracts background and divides by fitted amplitude; C scales residuals by estimated count SD; D changes fit start, with parameter standard errors from fit covariance. Data include a 0.12 ns response width and Poisson fluctuations.
